newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris judge notifies Carlos accomplice of probe.
newsitem.headline: Paris judge notifies Carlos accomplice of probe.

text.p: A Paris judge placed a suspected German accomplice of notorious guerrilla Carlos the Jackal under criminal investigation on Thursday for a 1982 bombing in the French capital, judicial sources said.

The sources said anti-terrorism investigating magistrate Jean-Louis Bruguiere notified Margo Froelich that she was suspected of complicity in the bombing, which killed a pregnant woman and injured 63 people. Froelich was extradited to Paris from Rome earlier on Thursday.

Bruguiere is leading several probes into bombings and attacks blamed on the Venezuelan-born Carlos, whose real name is Ilich Ramirez Sanchez, who has been in a French jail since August 1994 after he was captured in Sudan.
Justice sources said Froelich was suspected of being an accomplice to murder and to destroying property with explosives.

Arrested when she visited her jailed husband in Rome in October 1995, Froehlich refused to answer Bruguiere's questions on the April 1982 attack targetting the Arabic-language weekly newspaper, Al Watan Al Arabi, they said.
The attack is also thought to have been aimed at forcing the release from French jail of two other accomplices of Carlos.
